personal.bio: Building production-grade AI systems that solve real-world problems. I have worked on LLM-powered applications, Multimodal AI, RAG Systems and scalable ML pipelines.

projects.title: Findify
projects.subtitle: Multimodal AI Product Discovery Platform
projects.description: End-to-end multimodal search using CLIP embeddings and Weaviate. Sub-100ms retrieval across 7,000+ products.
projects.longDescription: Engineered end-to-end multimodal search (text + image) using CLIP embeddings and Weaviate named vectors, enabling product discovery by photo or natural-language description — sub-100ms retrieval across 7,000+ products validated at 250+ concurrent RPS. Built parallel Playwright scraping pipeline (Amazon, eBay, Alibaba) with ThreadPoolExecutor; reduced per-batch enrichment time ~60%, sourcing 7,000+ listings; Upstash Redis caching layer cut average retrieval latency 85% (35ms → <5ms). Resolved 4 production-blocking failures (Weaviate ingestion mismatch, ISP port-blocking, Railway RAM overflow, env var mismatches), bringing system from 0% to full search functionality.
projects.impact: Enables product discovery by photo or natural-language description across 7,000+ listings
projects.learnings: Production systems are hard—scaling, caching, debugging infrastructure failures taught me more than a semester of classes.

projects.title: MCP-Based SQL Analyst
projects.subtitle: NLP-Driven BI Assistant
projects.description: Conversational analytics for non-technical users querying complex data warehouses in plain English.
projects.longDescription: Built a conversational NLP-driven BI assistant allowing non-technical users to query a 2.5M-row retail warehouse in plain English, eliminating dependency on analysts for routine reporting. Implemented an MCP server with 11 capabilities as a read-only LLM gateway; achieved 100% adversarial block rate across all SQL injection and PII-extraction tests. Designed a YAML semantic layer mapping business terms to SQL metric formulas and safe join paths, eliminating schema ambiguity for the LLM.
achievements: YAML semantic layer for business term mapping
projects.impact: Non-technical users query complex data without analyst dependency; reduced reporting turnaround from hours to seconds
projects.learnings: Security-first design for LLM+DB systems is critical. MCP abstraction makes LLMs safer for data access.

projects.title: ShopScout
projects.subtitle: AI-Powered Intelligent Shopping Advisor
projects.description: LangGraph-based 4-node pipeline combining deterministic filtering with LLM ranking for hallucination-free recommendations.
projects.longDescription: Architected a 4-node LangGraph multi-agent pipeline combining deterministic PostreSQL filtering with LLM-based ranking; achieved 100% intent extraction accuracy parsing complex user constraints (budget, brand, specs). Eliminated search hallucinations by grounding LLM recommendations in real-time verified database context; used Ollama (Llama 3.2) as local fallback ensuring zero downtime on API failures. Built a BeautifulSoup scraping pipeline ingesting e-commerce catalog data into PostgreSQL (Supabase) and MongoDB, feeding the recommendation engine with verified product data.
achievements: Zero downtime with Ollama local fallback
Grounded LLM recommendations in verified data
projects.impact: Eliminates hallucinations through database-grounded recommendations; users trust suggestions because they're verified
projects.learnings: Combining symbolic reasoning (database queries) with neural networks (LLMs) creates robust systems neither can achieve alone.

projects.title: PlantDoc
projects.subtitle: Crop Disease Detection
projects.description: FastAPI + PyTorch system for real-time crop disease diagnosis. 99% accuracy across 38 disease classes.
projects.longDescription: Fine-tuned EfficientNet-B3 on a 54,000-image plant disease dataset; achieved 99% test accuracy across 38 classes with batch upload and real-time inference, enabling farmers to diagnose crop disease from a photo. Built with FastAPI backend and Streamlit frontend for accessibility.
achievements: Enables farmers to diagnose from photos
projects.impact: Agricultural AI: farmers diagnose crop diseases instantly, reducing crop loss and optimizing treatment
projects.learnings: AI for social impact—working on problems beyond tech itself is deeply motivating.

projects.title: Traffic Sign Recognition
projects.subtitle: Computer Vision Model
projects.description: Traffic sign recognition model built with CNNs for autonomous driving and driver assistance systems.
projects.longDescription: Developed a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) architecture to detect and classify traffic signs from images. Applied data augmentation techniques to improve model robustness across various lighting and weather conditions, optimizing for real-time edge inference.
achievements: Built custom CNN architecture for image classification
projects.impact: Enhances autonomous vehicle perception systems for safer navigation.
projects.learnings: Data augmentation is critical for computer vision models to generalize to real-world edge cases.

projects.title: HealthCare AI for Malaria
projects.subtitle: Automated Disease Diagnosis
projects.description: Malaria cell image classification using CNN for automated disease diagnosis.
projects.longDescription: Built a diagnostic AI tool utilizing Convolutional Neural Networks to classify cell images as infected or uninfected with malaria. Designed to assist healthcare professionals by accelerating the diagnostic process and reducing human error in microscopic analysis.
achievements: Trained CNN on microscopic cell imagery
projects.impact: Assists healthcare professionals by accelerating malaria diagnosis in clinical settings.
projects.learnings: Healthcare AI requires extreme precision and minimal false negatives to be clinically viable.
